author_scope: offline retained-face numerical audit only; no Rust, package.md, callback, or runtime changes

fixed_protocol.inputs: decode every A, f, p, lambda, radius and box value from captured 16-hex-digit IEEE-754 binary64 bits; retain bit identity in results
fixed_protocol.exact_evaluation: use Python Fraction.from_float for exact-rational r=f+A*p and h=A^T*r+lambda*p at each recorded p; compare with frozen ordered binary64 h_hat and independently reconstructed unchanged Gamma87/Cbar/tau
fixed_protocol.reference: at decimal precisions 100 and 200, use Decimal modified-Gram-Schmidt QR on the fixed free-face augmented system [A_free; sqrt(lambda) I] x = [-f-A_active*p_active; 0], then assess recorded-lambda stationarity; separately assess the fixed-face trust-ball minimizer only if the recorded multiplier/radius indicates its boundary, retaining active values and never changing masks
fixed_protocol.reference_checks: precision agreement, QR factorization residual/orthogonality, free stationarity, active equality, all original box bounds, and radius/multiplier consistency
fixed_protocol.binary64_reference: round each free reference coordinate once by conversion to binary64; restore active coordinates from their captured exact bound bits; do not clip or normalize; recompute frozen ordered BVLS-02 KKT/enclosure and feasibility

corrections.replay_gate: before a correction, replay the fixed current face's captured Jacobi/SVD factorization and require its reconstructed candidate p to match every captured binary64 bit; if it fails, record correction unavailable
corrections.factor_policy: only the verified replayed current-face Jacobi/SVD factors from the captured A/free mask may be reused; no independent QR reference factor, new active set, tolerance, seed, rank threshold, solver family, additional factorization, clipping, or projection
corrections.step_1: ordinary-binary64 residual correction using those reused current-face factors; update only free coordinates and preserve captured active values; test complete original bounds/radius/BVLS-02
corrections.step_2: one separate higher-precision-residual diagnostic: form the residual at 200 decimal digits, round that residual once to binary64, apply the same reused factors once, update the step-1 vector's free coordinates, and test complete criteria. It is explicitly not binary64-only attainability evidence. No additional correction branch exists.

fixed_protocol.reported: all coordinates, exact h, h_hat-exact_h, Cbar/tau, classifications, feasibility, radius, objective/residual, singular-value condition estimates, factor residual/orthogonality, operation counts and limits

interpretation_rule: Gamma87/tau bounds evaluation of h at supplied p; it does not certify forward step accuracy. No runtime recommendation is made unless the fixed protocol supports it.
